onboarding.step1.title: Welcome to Seeed Jetson Develop Tool
onboarding.step1.desc1: Your all-in-one workspace for Jetson development.
onboarding.step1.desc2: Let's get you started in just a few steps.
onboarding.step1.tip: 💡 This tool supports reComputer, reServer, and other Jetson devices.
onboarding.step2.title: Connect Your Device
onboarding.step2.desc1: Use a USB-C cable to connect your Jetson device to your computer.
onboarding.step2.desc2: Make sure the device is powered on and booting normally.
onboarding.step2.desc3: Type-C connection supports flashing, serial debug, and data transfer.
onboarding.step2.tip: 💡 For reComputer series, simply connect the Type-C port to your PC.
onboarding.step3.title: Network Connection
onboarding.step3.desc1: Jetson devices come with a pre-installed OS (JetPack) from factory.
onboarding.step3.desc2: Connect the device to your router/switch via Ethernet cable.
onboarding.step3.desc3: If you need to reinstall or upgrade, go to the Flash page.
onboarding.step3.tip: 💡 In most cases, no flashing is needed — the pre-installed system works out of the box!
onboarding.step4.title: Connect Remotely
onboarding.step4.desc1: Use Remote Desktop for a graphical interface to your Jetson.
onboarding.step4.desc2: Or use SSH for command-line access directly from the tool.
onboarding.step4.desc3: No extra software needed — everything is built in!
onboarding.step4.tip: 💡 You can switch between Remote Desktop and SSH anytime.
onboarding.step5.title: Explore Apps & Skills
onboarding.step5.desc1: Install popular AI applications from the App Market with one click.
onboarding.step5.desc2: Discover and run Skills to automate your Jetson workflows.
onboarding.step5.desc3: From LLM inference to computer vision — it's all here.
onboarding.step5.tip: 🚀 You're all set! Click 'Get Started' to begin your journey.
